title: knowledge(events): database trigger setup flags may only be set to true
summary: A new quality rule checks that database trigger setup flags in the Global Triggers event can only be set to true, preventing subscribers from inadvertently clearing flags set by other integrations or system features.
key_points: Detects when subscribers assign false to database trigger setup flags, which can disable Dataverse sync, webhooks, data archive, or change logging
Carves out demo data tools and test sessions where flag clearing is acceptable
Recommends using table-specific mechanisms instead of subscribing directly to system codeunits
Applies to AL versions 15 and later
Added to the al-events-review skill with both good and bad code samples
